name: Rhythmer Kit
description: 36 complete kits. Replace individual pad engines and sounds, shape each pad, and filter the whole kit.

name: Sophie
description: A dedicated drum instrument for building rhythmic character from individual sounds.

name: Elixir
description: Explore LXR, modal, Plaits and noise-oriented drum palettes.
authors: dmajka; Erica Synths; Julian Schmidt / Sonic Potions

name: Aphex
description: Explore the Aphex engine’s sound palette through the shared instrument interface.

name: FM-106
description: An FM voice for exploring bright tones, metallic edges and expressive synthetic sounds.

name: FMini-1
description: Minimoog Model D-style synthesis from the original FMini-1 2.6.0 engine, with 200 original factory presets. Three oscillators, revised filter response, contour shaping, LFO, modulation and source effects.
authors: Guilherme Ruppert; Leo Kuroshita / Hugelton Instruments

name: CS-1
description: Explore a compact synthesis voice through its exposed sound parameters and presets.

name: OberVave
description: Dual-oscillator shaping, envelopes and modulation, with chorus, delay and reverb controls.

name: K-WASUB
description: Oscillators, sub, noise and a modulation matrix, with drive and lo-fi shaping.
authors: Guizmoh; Omnipotard; Leo Kuroshita; zvenson; twochannels

name: Hera
description: Explore the Hera engine through a hardware-focused parameter and preset interface.

name: Braids
description: A macro-oscillator palette for exploring contrasting synthesis colours.
authors: Emilie Gillet / Mutable Instruments; Charles Vestal

name: Plaits
description: Multi-model synthesis for shifting between tonal and percussive textures.

name: Hortator
description: A percussion palette spanning TRX, classic drum flavours, FM and experimental textures.

name: MONO2K
description: Machine selection, filtering, arpeggiation, effects and three LFO sections to explore.
authors: Inigo Hernandez; Leo Kuroshita; original CS-1 / X0X / FoMni contributors

name: Prophet
description: Oscillator, filter, envelope and poly-mod sections brought into a paged editing layout.
authors: Kerem Kilic / Ellic Studio; Leo Kuroshita

name: S1Vave
description: An additional FM-1-derived instrument, adapted to the RHYTHMER sound host.
authors: Andrew GG / AndrewGG88; zvenson; Leo Kuroshita; isod89

name: Dexed
description: Explore the open-source FM instrument through its ported parameters and preset workflow.
authors: Pascal Gauthier / asb2m10; Google / MSFA contributors; Charles Vestal

name: Guru-600
description: Synth and effects controls integrated with the shared preset and sound-editing pages.

name: Frodhes
description: Electric-piano, vibraphone and marimba voices with 57 original programs. Shape the tone with source-native filters, envelopes, modulation and effects.
authors: Leonardo Mirabal; Leo Kuroshita; isod89; zvenson

name: Tenebrae
description: Eight oscillator models cover basses, leads, pads, keys and textured sounds. Explore 164 original programs including Init, with oscillator shaping, resonant filtering, envelopes and modulation.
